commentary.text: 90+8' Alejandro Hernandez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

90+7' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
90+6' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+5' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) but poses no threat.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Pep Chavarria, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

23' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

22' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
21' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
21' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

19' Rayo Vallecano players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
18' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' 1 - 0 Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) converts a killer cross with a curling shot inside the left post! What a perfect finish!
14' Atl. Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
12' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

12' What an amazing save by Augusto Batalla! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but fails.
12' Some neat passing and movement from Atl. Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
11' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.

7' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Hernandez saw the whole situation.
6' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
5' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.

3' Atl. Madrid are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
